_comment: eBay AU → local-buyer arbitrage finder (arbitrage.html, /api/arb). Server-owned: data/arbitrage.config.json is seeded from this file on boot and rewritten in place by a settings save. Money floors are AUD.
_comment_margin: margin is RETURN ON OUTLAY: profit / (price + postage + fee). 15 means fifteen cents back on every dollar spent.
_comment_fee: feeAU adds eBay AU's buyer-protection fee (lib/fees.mjs) to the landed cost; none leaves it out. Two live listing pages showed no fee line on 2026-09-12 — flip to none if a real checkout confirms there is none.
_comment_exclude: null = fall back to repricer.config.json exclude_seller_username, then EBAY_SELLER_USERNAME, so our own listings are never a hit.
_comment_dashboard: Where a Telegram card's 'All hits' button points, e.g. http://192.168.4.200:5273. Empty = use postsale.config.json dashboard_url, else no button.
_comment_sweep: The newly-listed sweep runs inside the watch pass over every enabled set in arb_sweep_sets. queries: name = 'Pokemon <set name>', number = 'Pokemon <printed total>' (catches the ~6% of titles that never name the set). Each page is one eBay call; a pass reads newest-first until it reaches the last watermark.
_comment_reference: The buyer prices off a stale TCGplayer Market snapshot (measured 2026-09-13: shelf = late-July market × 1.5, never repriced). enabled = score hits against buyer_pct × market-as-of-date × store_factor wherever a reference figure exists (typed-in, this module's daily snapshots, or the tracker); cards without one fall back to the live basis and are chipped. max_gap_days = how far from the date a snapshot may be and still count. min_drop_pct = the fall since the date that puts a card on the 'fallen since' list.
